disnote: These are the people whose acts put them in more than one faction, or against their own. Home faction is where most of their acts sit. A defection would show here first.
paras: The reviewed decisions show different kinds of power. The FOMC set rates and the Supreme Court resolved the IEEPA tariff question. USTR leads the Section 301 process under the applicable statute and presidential direction. Vance had negotiating access on Iran, and the Islamabad talks ended without a deal. The review leaves their effect on his succession standing unresolved.

Expanded review distinguishes Deal-Capital’s negotiating access and commercial opportunities from realized returns, and Treasury’s sanctions and rulemaking authority from the FOMC’s rate decisions. Legacy rankings shift across source tiers and time windows.
